description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lucian''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] for up to 3 seconds, rapidly firing up to 22 (+ 0 – 22[[Category:Debug]] (+ [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] 0 – 6[[Category:Debug]]) (based on critical strike chance)) shots in the target direction over the duration. Each shot deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, doubled against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]]. ''The Culling'' can be recast after 0.75 seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.

notes.text:
The Culling creates the shots at an offset of 35 units to the front plus 35 units towards each side of Lucian (sides alternating, first shot fired from Lucian's right gun), unlike the missiles of most abilities.
The fire rate increases with the number of shots.
During The Culling, Lucian's facing direction is in the direction that he is firing.
Lucian can interact with Dark Passage or allied Devour without interrupting The Culling.
The damage dealt by each bullet of The Culling is calculated when the bullet reaches a target, just like single missile abilities.
Spell shield only blocks one instance of damage.
